# TASK-061 — Role-aware user/admin/security/performance dashboards

- **Status:** Done — implemented and verified
- **Area:** Expanded scope (see expanded-scope.md for acceptance criteria)

## Intent

User dashboard, read-only Viewer dashboard, admin configuration, security administration, SSO status, data statistics and performance metrics.
